basic_details.job_title: Andhra Pradesh High Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Andhra Pradesh High Court Law Clerk Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of the Andhra Pradesh High Court. A total of 4 vacancies have been announced through the AP High Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 1st January / 1st July, preceding the last date fixed for submission of applications.
age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per rules.

qualification.details: Degree in Law from a recognized University, having studied a 5-year regular stream after completion of 10+2 years of schooling or who have studied (after 10+2) a regular curriculum degree course followed by a 3 year regular law degree from a University or a college affiliated to a recognized University. Passed the Degree in Law within 2 years immediately preceding the date of notification for selection of Law Clerks. Not pursuing any other regular course of study or profession/occupation that requires them to be away from their place of work. If enrolled as an Advocate, shall suspend practice before joining and keep it suspended till demitting Law Clerkship.

salary_details.details: Honorarium for appointed Law Clerks is fixed at Rs.35,000/- (Rupees Thirty Five thousand only) per month.

selection_process: Notification inviting applications Recommendation from Prominent Law Schools/Universities (optional) Application submission Viva voce Selection by a committee nominated by the Chief Justice Approval by the Chief Justice
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Andhra Pradesh High Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.aphc.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Andhra Pradesh High Court Law Clerk Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.aphc.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Law Clerk post in Andhra Pradesh High Court?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Law Clerk position at the Andhra Pradesh High Court is August 4, 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Law Clerk position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Law Clerk position, candidates must possess a Degree in Law from a recognized University. The degree should have been obtained within two years immediately preceding the notification date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to the Law Clerk post?
faq.answer: Candidates must not have attained the age of 30 years as on January 1st or July 1st, preceding the last date fixed for the submission of applications. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Law Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Law Clerk position will receive an honorarium of Rs. 35,000/- per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Law Clerk post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Law Clerk post announced by the Andhra Pradesh High Court.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Law Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for the Law Clerk recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Law Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an application submission followed by a viva voce. The final selection will be made by a committee nominated by the Chief Justice and approved by the Chief Justice.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the duly filled application form?
faq.answer: Duly filled applications should be sent to the Registrar (Recruitment), High Court of A.P. at Amaravati, Nelapadu, Guntur District, A.P., PIN Code - 522239, via Registered Post/Speed Post.

faq.question: Q10. Can an enrolled advocate apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, an enrolled advocate can apply, but they must suspend their practice before joining and keep it suspended throughout their tenure as a Law Clerk.
